# dna dns

DNS zone records of domains on the platform nameservers.

## dna dns add

```
dna dns add <domain> [flags]
```

Add values to a DNS record set (creates the set if needed).

Adds one or more values to the record set identified by --name and --type; existing values of that
set are kept. Names may be relative (www), the apex (@) or fully qualified. Record types are
case-sensitive in the API; the CLI fixes the case. TXT content is quoted automatically; CAA content
needs exactly 3 parts (`0 issue "letsencrypt.org"`); CNAME needs a name. Records only resolve
publicly once the domain uses the platform nameservers (see `dna dns apply`).

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/domains/zones`
- **Body:** `ZoneCreateInput`
- **Returns:** nothing (prints {"success":true})
- **Schema:** `dna schema dns.add` (MCP tool: `dns_add`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--type` | string | Record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA, ...) (see 'dna enums RecordType') (required) |
| `--content` | strings | Record value; repeat for several values (required) |
| `--name` | string | Record name, e.g. www (CNAME requires a name) |
| `--ttl` | int | TTL in seconds (1-86400, default 3600) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna dns add example.com --name www --type A --content 192.0.2.10 --ttl 3600
dna dns add example.com --name @ --type TXT --content "v=spf1 include:_spf.example.net ~all"
```

## dna dns apply

```
dna dns apply <domain> [flags]
```

Switch the domain to the platform nameservers so its DNS zone is served.

If the domain does not already use the platform's nameservers, its nameservers are changed to them,
so the records managed with `dna dns` become live. This replaces any external DNS provider (e.g.
Cloudflare) for the domain. Reports previous, current and system nameservers; does nothing when they
already match.

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/domains/zones/apply`
- **Returns:** `ZoneApplyResultDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema dns.apply` (MCP tool: `dns_apply`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

## dna dns delete

```
dna dns delete <domain> [flags]
```

Remove one value from a DNS record set.

Removes the value --content from the set --name + --type. Other values of the set stay.

- **Safety:** DESTRUCTIVE - deletes data or is hard to undo; asks for confirmation (--yes to skip)
- **API:** `DELETE /api/v1/domains/zones`
- **Returns:** nothing (prints {"success":true})
- **Schema:** `dna schema dns.delete` (MCP tool: `dns_delete`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--name` | string | Record name (required) |
| `--content` | string | Exact record value to delete (required) |
| `--type` | string | Record type (see 'dna enums RecordType') (required) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna dns delete example.com --name www --type A --content 192.0.2.10 --yes
```

## dna dns update

```
dna dns update <domain> [flags]
```

Replace a DNS record set with new values.

Replaces every value of the set --record-name + --type with the given --content values (and TTL);
--name can rename it. Use `dns add` to append a value instead.

- **Safety:** changes data (free)
- **API:** `PUT /api/v1/domains/zones`
- **Body:** `ZoneCreateInput`
- **Returns:** nothing (prints {"success":true})
- **Schema:** `dna schema dns.update` (MCP tool: `dns_update`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--record-name` | string | Name of the existing record set to replace (required) |
| `--ttl` | int | Ttl (1-86400) (required) |
| `--type` | string | Type (see 'dna enums RecordType') (required) |
| `--content` | strings | Record value; repeat for several values (required) |
| `--name` | string | New record name |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |

**Examples**

```bash
dna dns update example.com --record-name www --name www --type A --ttl 600 --content 192.0.2.20
```
